compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect dso.workflow config consolidation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update project reference documentation and create a new ADR documenting the decision to consolidate workflow-mode config into `dso.workflow`.

**Why**: doc-router Gates 2 and 4 fire: this change extends multiple existing reference docs and introduces a significant architectural decision that warrants an ADR. The reference docs remain exempt from SC6 grep verification (they may describe legacy keys for migration context), but they must teach `dso.workflow` as the primary entry point.

**Scope**:
- IN: `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` (teach `dso.workflow` as primary, four legacy keys documented as deprecated/migrated); `INSTALL.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, `dso-config.reference.conf` (update to reference `dso.workflow` as canonical config entry); new ADR in `docs/adr/` (decision rationale for hybrid shim + migrator approach); `CLAUDE.md` changes via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report only (not direct edits)
- OUT: Code changes, script changes, skill file changes (covered in S1-S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` teaches `dso.workflow` as the primary key, with the four legacy keys documented as deprecated and migrated
  ← Satisfies: doc-router Gate 2 (extends existing reference doc)
- When this story is complete, `INSTALL.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, and `dso-config.reference.conf` are updated to reference `dso.workflow` as the canonical config entry point
  ← Satisfies: doc-router Gate 2 (extends existing reference docs)
- When this story is complete, a new ADR in `docs/adr/` documents the decision to consolidate workflow-mode config into a single key and the rationale for the hybrid shim + migrator approach
  ← Satisfies: doc-router Gate 4 (decision rationale)
- When this story is complete, any proposed `CLAUDE.md` changes are delivered as `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` reports surfaced to the user — not applied directly
  ← Satisfies: CLAUDE.md governance rule

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Doc targets: `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, `dso-config.reference.conf`, new ADR. Do NOT create new documentation files beyond the ADR.
- Apply `/Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.17.0/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md` gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly. If `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` exists, follow it for formatting.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
